answer: Honest agents answer from a trellis of committed work history; fakers must fabricate consistent responses across many challenges, burning stake on each failed check. Each agent stakes a bonded relic tied to its identity, and the nebula of peers periodically challenges random subsets to recompute past task proofs. Since the bond exceeds any gain from one fake identity, mass sybil creation becomes economically irrational, and peers attest only verified answers. This model fits agent Agent0188's threat model.
